verdict.rationale: The only machine-readable spec in the evidence is the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the general OpenAI REST API (codex-gh-9). That is the host platform's API, not a spec for Codex itself, so it earns no credit. Codex's own programmatic surface, the experimental and deprecated MCP-server JSON-RPC interface, is documented only in prose, with no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent schema shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
